project.name: Ledgerly
objectives: Produce a trial balance on demand.

contract.authorizes: A pilot with three partner accounting teams on non-production books.
operating_envelope: At most 1 million transactions per book.

requirements.statement: Every posted transaction balances to zero.
requirements.criterion: The property test over 10000 random transactions finds no unbalanced posting.

requirements.statement: A crash during posting never leaves a partial transaction.
requirements.criterion: Fault injection at every write boundary leaves the book consistent.

requirements.statement: Account data is readable only by its owners.
requirements.criterion: The access matrix test passes for all role and account pairs.

unacceptable.statement: Silent loss of a posted transaction.
Disclosure of one tenant's books to another.

accepted.statement: Reports may lag writes by up to five seconds.

not_applicable.rationale: The pilot is capped at three teams.

calibrations.evidence_needed: Latency measurements from the pilot workload.
calibrations.reassess_when: Two weeks of pilot traffic exist.

instructions: You are the reviewer. Assess every domain and every applicable requirement; do not modify the repository.

fix.summary: Hold the book mutex across the read-modify-write in Post.
fix.root_cause: The balance cache was introduced without a lock discipline.

finding.title: Concurrent posts can overwrite each other
finding.description: Post reads the balance, then writes it back without a lock, so two concurrent posts lose one update.
finding.evidence: go test -race ./internal/ledger -run TestConcurrentPost fails 7 of 10 runs.
finding.impact: A posted transaction is silently lost with 50 concurrent users.
finding.blocking_rationale: A pilot with partner books must not lose transactions.

decisions.text: Every fix to internal/ledger includes a race test.
